mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings growth for consumer-sensitive sectors and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals contraction in manufacturing activity, reducing earnings for industrial firms and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points and a decline in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 50,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 50,000 in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% combined with a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer demand and housing activity, which reduces earnings growth for consumer-sensitive and construction sectors and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 1% AND HOUST falls > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% AND HOUST falls > 5% in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals a macroeconomic downturn, which reduces earnings expectations across sectors and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where GDPC1 falls > 2% over 2 quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
